_help: Drafted details for the background furs who had empty records - mostly FurNet IRC lurkers, written to fit the channel they sit in and their away tags (2026-10-17). apply_drafts.py fills only empty fields and marks each one for review. Edit freely.

fursona.colors: black with a white chest, chin and paws
fursona.markings: a white bib like a dress shirt
fursona.description: A dapper black-and-white tuxedo cat who looks permanently dressed for a party he's late to.

Tuxedo.summary: Tuxedo (Owen Pryce) is a #furnet regular who's 'away' far more often than he's here.
Tuxedo.personality: Easygoing and polite; turns up, says hi to everyone, then wanders off.
Tuxedo.mannerisms: • Sets |away and forgets about it for hours

fursona.description: A huge, gentle brown bear, almost always asleep in at least one channel.

Kodiak.mannerisms: • Leaves his client running and falls asleep: Kodiak|zzz
Kodiak.interests: Fishing, camping and bear suits at cons.
